rubrics.justification: The response misclassifies the embryo as a compacting morula/early blastocyst (Stage 1-2) despite the provided lab grade of 2CA indicating a full blastocyst, and it does not accurately address the poor ICM and cohesive TE.
The visible response does not integrate patient age, PCOS, prior live birth, sperm parameters, ovarian response, or endometrial thickness with embryo quality.
The reasoning is internally limited and based on an incorrect morphological premise, so downstream conclusions would be weakly supported even if not overtly contradictory.
The morphology assessment conflicts with Gardner grading provided in the case, indicating poor alignment with standard blastocyst grading criteria; no clear evidence-based transfer planning is shown.
The response is truncated and provides no concrete transfer recommendations, prognosis counseling, or future cycle planning.
